summary: scoreRisk's explainable output must contain a phase factor entry for every trial — Phase 2 and unknown/unposted phases included — never only for the phases that happen to match a switch case.
reason: The generated phase-attrition switch omitted PHASE2 and unknown phases, so the phase signal silently vanished from the auditable factor list for the most common attrition point in drug development; a reviewer could not tell whether phase was considered. Guarded by TestScoreRiskPhaseFactorAlwaysPresent.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/ passes with explicit phase-factor assertions for EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, unknown enum, and no phases posted.
